listing.summary: Just a bunch of weapons I made that I thought were cool but couldn't find anywhere to put them. Weighted pretty low so its rare you'll see any of them.

description:
Just a bunch of weapons I made that I thought were cool but couldn't find anywhere to put them. Weighted pretty low so its rare you'll see any of them.

Examples:

- Shielded Missiles
- Weapons that just project shields
- A sawn-off sabot

This is what I call a **fucko mod**. Pristine balance is not a concern and I will probably not support it forever

Save to add to new games, not safe to remove.

Download: https://github.com/nikothedude/Niko-SWP/releases
Repo: https://github.com/nikothedude/Niko-SWP
